sections.title: Project overview
sections.content: Build a new website for our small bakery that lets customers order cakes online

sections.title: Key details
sections.content:
Deliverables:
- menu page
- order form
- contact page
Deadline: before the holiday season
Budget: around $3,000
Constraints:
- should look modern but also traditional

sections.title: Gaps and risks
sections.content:
- "Modern but also traditional" can be read several ways and gives no usable design direction.
- "Before the holiday season" gives no concrete launch date.
- Online cake ordering may imply payment processing and order management, which the brief does not mention.
The target audience is not stated; the client should confirm it.

sections.title: Questions to ask
sections.content:
- What is the exact date the website needs to be live?
- Could you share one or two websites whose look you like, and say what feels modern and what feels traditional about them?
- Should customers pay on the website, or only send an order that you confirm and charge yourself?

response_json.summary: The brief is not ready to start: confirm the exact launch date first.
